ops.title: move durable untrack out of the settlement reserve
ops.description: Follow-up from the 2026-07-24 pool-wedge incident fix (v0.19.0). The fix converts outcome (crash-restart instead of wedged-but-alive), not cause: multi-second flock'd store stalls during child settlement still blow the 1.5s reserve and terminalize the claim (refuter finding, LOW). Move the durable untrack (Store.Remove) out of the settlement-critical path so store I/O latency cannot terminalize the claim; a stale record is already handled by next-generation Recover. Related finder observation: the new grace-phase early-settle poll reads the flock'd store every settlementPollInterval (10ms) — up to ~500 reads per TERM-resistant orphan at the 5s default grace; moving store I/O off the hot path addresses that too.

ops.text: a settlement whose Store.Remove stalls multi-second no longer terminalizes the claim
leaked records from deferred untrack are reaped by next-generation Recover (test)
